summary.prose: Building s5 is mostly re-ordering and naming inside the analyzer, plus one new piece of state in the daemon. The analyzer's four context-builder defects are closed first (typed model failures, the call named, two named pipeline causes, cache before scope), then the run's scope refusal moves ahead of the size announcement. The full index gains an in-memory record of its progress and writes its final figures once onto the registry row; one check reads them to refuse, with 'repo-indexing', any analyzer request or graph-reading search request or graph tool about a repository under index, and cross-repository results leave such a repository out. It ships with a daemon update; no store migration and no re-index.

tasks.title: The local provider raises ModelCallFailedError on every transport failure; the retry helper keeps the type
tasks.summary: In src/agent/providers/ollama.ts, wrapOllamaError and every call site that rethrows a transport error (complete with its retry, stream creation, an error thrown while a stream is iterated) raise ModelCallFailedError. In src/agent/providers/structured-output.ts the retry helper re-throws a ModelCallFailedError (detail prefixed with its attempt count) when its last attempt threw one, instead of a plain Error. The provider wraps every transport failure the Ollama client raises (from the call and from inside each for-await stream loop) as ModelCallFailedError with the original as cause; it does not filter on a list of message texts. tasks.title: The full index keeps an in-process running record and writes lastRun once at its end
tasks.summary: A new leaf module src/indexer/run-record.ts holds the daemon's in-process index-run record (IndexRunView { repoPath, startedAt, filesSelected?, filesDone }) and exports open / update / close / read-by-path; it imports nothing beyond types, so the analyzer's invariants.ts can read it without importing the indexer. tasks.title: runShaper looks up the cache before resolving the scope; bundles record their repository
tasks.summary: BundleMeta.repoPath: string | null (src/analyze/context/types.ts), admitted by the bundle schema's meta (src/analyze/context/schema.ts) as optional ['string','null'], written on every bundle. runShaper (src/analyze/context/driver.ts) looks up the cache first: a hit with a string repoPath runs ensureRepoQueryable and the freshness read for that repository only; null is served as today; a missing key is a miss. On a miss the scope is resolved once, ensureRepoQueryable runs for every source, then the pairing check, the code-only empty-closure check and the pipeline as today. ShapeOpts.scopeChecked (passed by the factory in src/analyze/context/index.ts into RunShaperArgs.opts) skips the repeated checks; it is not part of the cache key. Grounding: the factory in src/analyze/context/index.ts passes the caller's ShapeOpts whole as runShaper's opts (:93-100, :113-120, :138-145), so scopeChecked reaches runShaper without a new pass-through. Grounding of today's order: src/analyze/context/driver.ts builds the cache key at :336, resolves the scope at :350 (prepareScope), reads freshness from the resolved scope at :357 and looks up the cache at :360. After the change a hit takes its freshness path from the bundle's recorded repoPath, not from a resolved scope.

OllamaProvider: a connection refused / socket hang up / stream ended early is raised as ModelCallFailedError
classifyShaperError: the three new errors map to 'repo-indexing' (with data), 'index-state-read-failed' and 'lookup-failed'
registry codec: a row with lastRun round-trips; an older row without it decodes with lastRun undefined
runAnalyze: a request about a repository under index ends with code 'repo-indexing' through the orchestrator's mapping (not 'internal-error'); index-state-read-failed and lookup-failed likewise
analyze.classify on an unindexed scope answers 'scope-not-indexed' and returns no measured size; on a repository under index, 'repo-indexing'
runShaper: a cache hit for a bundle whose repository is now being indexed is refused with RepoIndexingError and the bundle is not returned; a bundle without repoPath is a miss
ensureRepoQueryable: a docs / data / infra / generic run on a repository under index is refused; an 'error' row without lastRun is refused with figures unknown and its errorMsg
plan walk: the walker (executor/walker.ts) records a task whose scope's repository is under index with code 'repo-indexing' through taskRefusalMapping
registry codec: decodeRepoRow keeps lastRun, and a status write without lastRun keeps the stored one
ensureRepoQueryable: a registry read that throws, and a pristine registry, skip the check (no refusal, no raw error)

isModelCallFailure: a ModelCallFailedError thrown on the last attempt of the retry helper is still a ModelCallFailedError (and a plain 'structured-output: ... attempts: Model call failed: ...' message is recognised); classifyOllamaError from runFinalStructuredEmit reads 'The model call for the final structured emit failed: ...'
runShaper: a connection-scope bundle (repoPath null) is served from cache; runAnalyze's scopeChecked option reaches runShaper through ShapeOpts and does not change the cache key
run order: a docs request on an unindexed scope emits no 'classified' event and ends failed at classify with the moved check's code and message
bundle schema: a freshly built bundle with repoPath (a string and null) passes validateBundleWithErrors; an older bundle without it still validates
OllamaProvider: a socket failure during stream iteration is raised as ModelCallFailedError

each consumer family of isModelCallFailure (the classifier, the planner, the summariser, the aggregator, the synthesizer and the decomposer) on a stand-in Ollama socket failure still reports the model as unavailable, not a shape failure

full index: during a run the in-process record shows began and files done of selected; at the end the registry row's lastRun is written once with outcome 'completed' or 'failed' (a forced failure mid-walk), and the record is closed; no write per file (counted)

search requests: search.callers / search.callees / search.by_file / search.closure / entity.summary / repo.depends_on / locate.inferParents about a repository being indexed answer 'repo-indexing: ...' with the figures and no result; about another, ready repository they answer as before
search.query while one repository is being indexed returns rows from the other repositories only

analyze through the daemon (analyze.context.buildRun and the step tools via step.call) on a repository being indexed returns code 'repo-indexing' with the figures; the workflow step that reaches it passes the reply on unchanged
entity.closure / entity.unreachable with a root in a repository under index are refused; search.callers across repositories leaves out the entities of a repository under index
the built-in graph tools (graph_entity, graph_callers, graph_callees, graph_query) about a repository under index fail with 'repo-indexing'; graph_search leaves such a repository out

entity.closure, entity.unreachable, search.closure, repo.depends_on, repo.search_cross_repo and graph_query from a ready repository whose closure reaches a repository under index leave that repository's entities out
